propositions: The `--reason` flag is advertised on all transition subcommands but is silently discarded on plain (non-force) close operations
The `close_reason` parameter is threaded through `transition_core()` signature and call sites but is never read or used in the function body
The `--reason` value is only meaningfully applied when `--force` is used; on non-force paths it is set to an empty string
Recent design (ticket ed13) deliberately replaced free-text close rationale with bounded `CLOSE_CLASSES` vocabulary scoped to the status edge
Documentation and code must be made consistent: `--reason` scope must be explicitly limited to force paths, or the flag must reject non-force use with clear error
